VBO:0200052.summary: Affectionate with his family, twenty-month-old Pablo was playful yet also relaxed in his owner’s account of an American Lo-Sze Pugg. On outings he avoided unfamiliar people trying to touch him. Walks mattered to his routine, and house training had taken a very long time. Sixteen-year-old Ming Ming enjoyed cuddles, walks, play and toys.
VBO:0200052.shortDescription: Pablo’s owner described a playful, affectionate Lo-Sze Pugg who could relax at home but avoided strangers’ touch.
